title.en: South Korean bank launches first Bitcoin-backed loans

current_state.zh: South Korea saw its first loans from traditional banks backed by bitcoin as collateral, extending crypto into mainstream bank credit in a major regulated market.
current_state.en: South Korea saw its first loans from traditional banks backed by bitcoin as collateral, extending crypto into mainstream bank credit in a major regulated market.

updates.title_zh: South Korean bank launches Bitcoin-backed business loans: Report
updates.title_en: South Korean bank launches Bitcoin-backed business loans: Report
updates.what_changed_zh: South Korea's Jeonbuk Bank has reportedly begun offering Bitcoin-backed won-denominated loans to corporate customers, using a third-party custodian and relying on amended Civil Enforcement Rules that allow courts to seize and liquidate crypto collateral in case of default.
